cards.name: CC Light Rays
cards.summary: Shoots volumetric light rays outward from a centre point, streaking the layer's own bright pixels (or a chosen colour) like god rays through a window.
use_for: god rays behind a leader or logo reveal in a trailer
heavenly/epic light burst on a title card
light-through-flags burst on a rally or ceremony shot
streaky glow transition at a cut
avoid: washes out faces and text at high Intensity
rays only come from bright areas, so a dark frame shows little
overused, reads as cheap 2000s trailer

params.name: Center
params.typical: on the light source or logo, e.g. [960, 300]

params.name: Radius
params.does: size of the source area that emits rays

params.name: Color from Source
params.does: 1 = rays take image colours, 0 = use Color

params.name: Color
params.does: ray colour when Color from Source is off

params.name: Transfer Mode
params.does: how rays combine with the image (popup)

cards.scripting: Harvested default Center is [480, 270] (quarter-frame), so always set Center explicitly in 1920x1080. Direction only rotates the Square shape (Shape 2). Transfer Mode: 1 None, 2 Add (default), 3 Lighten, 4 Screen (read from After Effects 26.0). Color from Source, Allow Brightening are 0/1 checkboxes.

verified.note: Bright volumetric bloom with radial streaks radiating from the top centre, washing out the bright upper-left area as the avoid note warns.

cards.name: CC Light Sweep
cards.summary: Passes a bright band of light across the layer, like a glint sliding over chrome; on layers with alpha it also lights the edges.
use_for: shine across a channel logo or bug at the end of a reel
glint over a title or lower-third as it lands
premium sweep on a trailer title card
highlight sweep over a product or award photo
avoid: too wide or slow a sweep looks like a smear
on full-frame footage without alpha the edge light does nothing
repeating it on every title gets tacky

params.name: Center
params.does: position of the light band (animate this)

params.name: Direction
params.does: angle of the band in degrees

cards.scripting: Animate Center, not Direction. Apply to a precomp or text/logo layer so Edge Intensity has alpha edges to light. Light Reception 3 (Cutout) keeps only the lit band of the layer (exact behaviour unverified); use 1 (Add) for the normal glint. Center has no clamp, so off-frame keyframes (-300 to 2200) are fine.

verified.note: A sharp bright diagonal band at about -30 degrees crosses the frame through the centre, glinting over the stripes and the centre.

cards.name: CC Threads
cards.summary: Re-renders the layer as a woven fabric of criss-crossing threads coloured by the underlying image.
use_for: textile/handloom texture for a story on weavers or khadi
stylised background plate behind titles
texture-in transition on a still photo
avoid: destroys faces and text detail
small Width/Height on 1080p looks like noise

params.name: Coverage
params.does: how much of the image is covered by threads

cards.scripting: Match name is 'CS Threads' (not 'CC Threads'): use the match name when applying. All params are plain numbers; Center is in px.

verified.note: Whole frame re-rendered as a woven basket-weave of threads coloured by the photo; faces lose detail.

cards.name: Cell Pattern
cards.summary: Generates an animated cellular texture (bubbles, crystals, plates, static) that replaces the layer.
use_for: procedural background texture under explainer graphics
track-matte source for a cellular/shatter-style transition
displacement/luma map for organic distortion
sci-fi or biology-themed backdrop
avoid: replaces the footage completely; use on a solid
HQ patterns are slow at large sizes
untinted grey cells look unfinished; colourise

params.name: Contextual Slider
params.does: Contrast or Sharpness depending on pattern

params.name: Overflow
params.does: how values outside 0-1 are handled (1 Clip, 2 Soft Clamp, 3 Wrap Back)

cards.scripting: Cell Pattern (read from After Effects 26.0): 1 Bubbles, 2 Crystals, 3 Plates, 4 Static Plates, 5 Crystallize, 6 a separator, 7 Pillow, 8 Crystals HQ, 9 Plates HQ, 10 Static Plates HQ, 11 Crystallize HQ, 12 Mixed Crystals, 13 Tubular. 'Contextual Slider' is Contrast (Sharpness for the Static Plates patterns). Evolution raw value is degrees (360 = 1 revolution). Apply to a solid; it replaces the layer. No Premiere 2026 equivalent.

verified.note: Footage fully replaced by a grey-white Bubbles cellular texture with dark seams.

cards.name: Checkerboard
cards.summary: Draws a checkerboard pattern over (or instead of) the layer.
use_for: graphic background for explainer cards
transition matte (checker wipe) via track matte
retro/80s or chequered-flag styling
avoid: Blending Mode 1 (None) discards the footage
looks dated if used full opacity over footage

params.name: Size From
params.does: 1 Corner Point, 2 Width Slider, 3 Width & Height Sliders

params.name: Width#2
params.does: Feather / Width: soft edge of squares

cards.equivalent: Premiere: no Checkerboard effect in v26; for a checker wipe use the CheckerBoard or Checker Wipe transition
cards.scripting: Two properties are named Width and Height: the checker size is 'Width'/'Height', the Feather group's are 'Width#2'/'Height#2'. Blending Mode is a 23-item popup: 1 = None (pattern only), 2 = Normal; 3 Stencil Alpha, then the layer modes with separators at 4, 11, 14 and 19 (enum_labels, read from After Effects 26.0).

verified.note: White 60%-opacity checker squares about 120 px wide alternate with untouched footage squares across the frame.

cards.name: Circle
cards.summary: Draws a solid disc or ring (optionally feathered or inverted) on the layer.
use_for: ring callout around a face or object in a news explainer
inverted feathered circle as a spotlight/vignette on one person
iris-in/iris-out transition
pulsing dot or radar ping on a map
avoid: hard-edged ring over footage looks cheap; add feather or a thin ring
default Blending Mode 1 (None) hides the footage

params.name: Edge
params.does: 1 None (disc), 2 Edge Radius, 3 Thickness, 4 Thickness*Radius, 5 Thickness & Feather*Radius

params.name: Contextual Slider
params.does: edge radius / thickness, depending on Edge

cards.equivalent: Premiere: none in v26; draw an ellipse Shape in a Graphic clip or use an ellipse Opacity mask
cards.scripting: Blending Mode default 1 = None renders only the circle on transparency; use 2 (Normal) to see the footage. Spotlight: Edge 1, Invert Circle 1, Color #000000, Opacity 60, Feather Outer Edge 150, Blending Mode 2.

verified.note: Thin yellow ring of radius about 300 px drawn over the footage around the frame centre, footage kept by Normal blending.

cards.name: Ellipse
cards.summary: Draws a soft glowing elliptical ring with separate inside and outside colours, like a neon tube.
use_for: neon ring highlight around a subject in a reel
HUD/target reticle on a map or face
halo or portal glow behind a title
avoid: Width/Height max out at 2000 px
without Composite On Original the footage is replaced by transparency
the harvested default colours are an odd green/blue or pink/red pair; always set both colours
cards.equivalent: Premiere: none in v26; draw an ellipse Shape in a Graphic clip
cards.scripting: Always set Inside Color and Outside Color explicitly: the harvested defaults ([1, 0.745, 0.98, 0.725] and [1, 0.098, 0.098, 0.588]) are ambiguous about channel order. Composite On Original is a 0/1 checkbox. Softness is a raw 0-1 value.

verified.note: Cyan-glow white elliptical ring about 900x600 px drawn over the footage at centre.

cards.name: Eyedropper Fill
cards.summary: Samples the colour at a point in the layer and floods the layer with that colour, optionally blended with the original.
use_for: colour-matched backing bar: apply to a masked duplicate of the footage so the bar takes the shot's own colour
colour wash/tint of footage towards a sampled colour
flash frame in the shot's own colour
avoid: sample point on a moving subject flickers
Blend With Original 0 replaces the shot with flat colour

params.name: Sample Point
params.typical: on a flag or wall area

params.name: Average Pixel Colors
params.does: 1 Skip Empty, 2 All, 3 All Premultiplied, 4 Including Alpha

cards.scripting: Blend With Original is a raw 0-1 fraction (UI shows %). Average Pixel Colors labels medium-confidence. Sampled colour updates per frame; keep Sample Point static on a stable area.

verified.note: Whole frame washed toward the sampled muted blue-grey (about 64% fill, contrast cut to a third), footage still readable underneath.

cards.name: Fill
cards.summary: Replaces the layer's opaque area (or a chosen mask) with a solid colour; Opacity fades the filled layer itself rather than mixing the colour with the footage.
use_for: recolour text, logos or icons to brand colour
silhouette of a cut-out person for a 'who is this?' reveal
solid colour flash frame on a beat (on a duplicate or solid layer above the footage)
colour wash: Fill on a duplicate layer above the footage, then set that layer's blend mode (Color, Multiply) or opacity
avoid: on full-frame footage with no alpha it just becomes a flat colour frame
Opacity below 1 makes the whole layer translucent over what is beneath (black on a lone layer); it does not mix the colour with the footage
Fill Mask cannot be set from a spec

params.name: Opacity
params.does: opacity of the filled result 0-1; lowers the layer's own alpha, not a mix with the original
params.typical: 1 (animate 0-1 on a layer above the footage for flashes)

cards.scripting: Opacity is a raw 0-1 fraction (UI shows %). Verified render: on full-frame footage the result is a flat colour; Opacity 0.6 gives a darker flat colour over black, with no footage showing through. For a flash or wash over footage, apply Fill to a duplicate or solid layer above the footage and animate that layer. Fill Mask is a mask-reference property (type mask) and cannot be set from a spec; left at None it fills the whole layer alpha. The recipe (Opacity 0 -> 1 -> 0) is a flash for a duplicate or solid above the footage; keyed on the footage layer itself it fades in from black and back to black.

verified.note: Frame is now one uniform bright red (renders RGB 212,10,42, close to #E8202A under the project's colour handling) instead of the old dim dark red (126,5,26) from Opacity 0.6, which is exactly what the card says Fill does to a full-frame layer with no alpha.
verified.second_opinion: corrected: agree with 'wrong' and the text rewrite (104.png is one uniform dark red, no footage), but demo Opacity 0.6 demonstrated the card's own pitfall (layer dimmed over black, not the real colour); demo set to Opacity 1 so the frame shows the true #E8202A fill; scripting notes the recipe belongs on a layer above the footage

cards.name: Fractal
cards.summary: Renders a Mandelbrot or Julia set fractal with cycling colour palettes over the layer.
use_for: trippy infinite-zoom background for an AI/maths explainer
psychedelic transition or dream sequence
abstract sci-fi texture behind titles
avoid: reads as a 90s screensaver if used plainly
deep magnification with high Escape Limit renders slowly
replaces the footage unless Overlay is on

params.name: Magnification
params.does: zoom level of the Mandelbrot view

params.name: X (Real)
params.typical: -0.7436 with Y 0.1318 (Seahorse Valley, on the set edge); default -0.703 sits inside the set

params.name: Y (Imaginary)
params.typical: 0.1318 for Seahorse Valley; 0 on the axis

cards.scripting: Property names repeat across groups: Mandelbrot = 'X (Real)', 'Y (Imaginary)', 'Magnification', 'Escape Limit'; Julia = the same names with '#2'; Post-inversion offset = 'X (Real)#3', 'Y (Imaginary)#3'. X/Y are complex-plane coordinates of the view centre; Magnification looks logarithmic (range -29..100, each step roughly doubles the zoom), unverified. Never zoom into the default centre (-0.703, 0): it is inside the set and the frame ends as flat colour; zoom on a boundary point such as (-0.7436, 0.1318). Set Choice: 1 Mandelbrot, 2 Mandelbrot Inverse, 3 Mandelbrot over Julia, 4 Mandelbrot Inverse over Julia, 5 Julia, 6 Julia Inverse; Equation: 1 z = z^2 + c ... 4 z = z^7 + c; Palette: 1 Lightness Gradient, 2 Hue Wheel, 3 Black And White, 4 Solid Color, 5 Escape Angle, 6 Grayscale, 7 Apple ][ (read from After Effects 26.0). Oversample settings only apply at Best quality.

verified.note: Footage replaced by a green-palette Mandelbrot set view (main cardioid and period-2 bulb) centred near the Seahorse Valley point.

cards.name: Gradient Ramp
cards.summary: Draws a linear or radial colour gradient between two points, optionally blended with the original layer.
use_for: gradient backgrounds for explainer and title cards
darken the bottom of a shot for caption legibility
gradient track matte for soft wipes
tint a sky or wash footage in brand colours
avoid: 8-bit gradients band; add Ramp Scatter or work in 16-bit
Blend With Original 0 replaces the footage
cards.scripting: Blend With Original is a raw 0-1 fraction (UI shows %). For a caption scrim put it on a solid in Multiply or with layer opacity rather than on the footage. Points are comp pixels.

verified.note: Linear orange-to-blue gradient blended 50% with the footage: warm orange top, blue bottom.

cards.name: Grid
cards.summary: Draws a grid of lines (tech/blueprint style) over or instead of the layer.
use_for: HUD/tech overlay for AI or data explainers
graph-paper backdrop behind charts and numbers
rule-of-thirds or framing guides for analysis segments
avoid: bright full-opacity grid over faces is distracting
Blending Mode 1 (None) hides the footage
thin 1px lines shimmer on scaled or moving layers

params.name: Size From
params.does: 1 Corner Point, 2 Width Slider, 3 Width & Height Sliders

cards.scripting: Default Size From is 1 (Corner Point): cell size comes from the Corner point, so set Size From 3 to use Width/Height. Feather properties are 'Width#2'/'Height#2'. Blending Mode: 1 = None (grid only on transparency), 2 = Normal; rest unverified. No Premiere 2026 equivalent. Rule-of-thirds: Size From 3, Width 640, Height 360.

verified.note: Thin white 45%-opacity grid lines at about 160 px cells over the footage; visible but light.
